scope: All ten numbered findings in the selected report; C03-06 separates its factual premise from its inference/conclusion.

claims.report_quote: **C03-01.** The four sampled payments total exactly 275000 euro cents (EUR 2750.00). Citation: ledger L-02.
claims.verification_question: Do all four listed payments sum to exactly 275000 cents, equivalent to EUR 2750.00?

claims.report_quote: **C03-02.** The budget exceeds the sampled payment total by exactly 35000 euro cents (EUR 350.00). Citations: ledger L-02, L-03.
claims.verification_question: Is the sample-only budget minus the actual four-payment total 35000 cents?

claims.report_quote: **C03-03.** Exactly two of the four sampled entries have approval exceptions, giving an exact sample exception rate of 50%. Citations: ledger L-02; method M-02.
claims.verification_question: Are exactly two of the four selected entries approval exceptions, and is the exact sample rate 50%?

claims.report_quote: **C03-04.** Exactly 50% of the entire 20-entry population has approval exceptions. Citations: ledger L-01, L-02; method M-01.
claims.verification_question: Does the sample establish that exactly ten of the twenty population entries had missing approvals?

claims.report_quote: **C03-05.** Sampled payments with missing approvals total exactly 75000 euro cents. Citation: ledger L-02.
claims.verification_question: Do the sampled payments with absent required approvals sum to 75000 cents?
Did all four sampled payments match their invoices?

claims.report_quote: **C03-06.** Because all four invoices matched, every sampled payment had its required approval at the cutoff. Citation: inspection I-01.
claims.verification_question: Does universal invoice matching establish that every sampled payment had required approval at the cutoff?

claims.report_quote: **C03-07.** Inspection paragraph I-01 says that no sampled payments were missing required approvals. Citation: inspection I-01.
claims.verification_question: Does I-01 literally state that no sampled payments were missing required approvals?

claims.report_quote: **C03-08.** Annex C confirms that both missing approvals were obtained after the cutoff. Citation: annex register A-01.
claims.verification_question: Does the supplied evidence establish Annex C’s contents or that both missing approvals were obtained after the cutoff?

claims.report_quote: **C03-09.** The invoice matching process is impressively elegant. Citation: inspection I-02.
claims.verification_question: Is “impressively elegant” an operationally defined, evidence-verifiable assessment here?

claims.report_quote: **C03-10.** At least two entries in the 20-entry population had missing required approvals at the cutoff. Citations: ledger L-01, L-02.
claims.verification_question: Does the known sample establish at least two missing-approval entries in the twenty-entry population at cutoff?
